//: Studio-layer numbers for this game, applied by Falcon IDE at publish time. Delete a key to keep its default.
//winCoins: Coins awarded for clearing a level.
//x2MinLevel: First level (1-based) where the win popup offers a rewarded-ad x2.
//rateLevel: Level after which the rate-us prompt may show; rateGateStars = stars that open the store.
//revivePrice: Coins for the first revive; each further one costs revivePriceStep more; maxRevives per round.
//boosterBarFromLevel: Level (1-based) from which the booster bar is shown, if the game declares boosters.
//ads: Interstitials: from minLevel (1-based), at most one per capSec seconds, shown with probability chance.
//lives: max lives; one regenerates every regenSec seconds.
//removeAds: The shop product that removes ads, and the price shown before the store answers.
